description.narrative: All around Libya. ICRC has offices in Sabha, Benghazi and Tripoli.
Contribution to the Libya ICRC appeal in 2026, as it's underfunded, with the campaign money received for Lybia

In Libya, political fragmentation continues to fuel tensions between institutions and armed groups aligned with them. Sporadic clashes between armed groups have caused deaths, injuries and displacement. The ICRC endeavours to promote respect for IHL among the pertinent parties, particularly in connection with protecting civilians and in clarifying the fate of missing people. The ICRC supports the local authorities and the Libyan Red Crescent in addressing the immediate needs of conflict-affected people linked to essential services and in maintaining family contact, and helps build their capacities in this regard. It will seek to visit people detained in connection with conflict, to monitor their treatment and living conditions.
